programs.title: Barry
programs.sub_title: Listen With Your Ears, React With Your Face
programs.desc: Barry (Bill Hader) is a low-end hitman.He is depressed, feels lonely and burnt out.Despite his reluctance, he accepts an assignment in Los Angeles, where he is to eliminate a young, aspiring actor.While tracking his target, he comes across a meeting of a theater group.Surprisingly, he feels great in the company of artists.Under their influence, he comes to the conclusion that he would like to break up with his current profession.However, it is not that simple.The originators of the series are Alec Berg, a five-time Emmy candidate, and Bill Hader, who plays the title character.The screen shows, among others:winner of two Golden Globes, Henry Winkler and Stephen Root.

programs.title: Ghostlight
programs.desc: Grieving construction worker Dan (Keith Kupferer) joins a local theater group working on a production of Romeo and Juliet.There are changes in his life.

programs.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
programs.desc: The Fellowship of the Ring has been broken.Frodo and Sam continue their journey to Mordor - the only place where the Ring can be destroyed.They manage to capture Gollum, one of the previous owners of the magical gem.Frodo decides to trust him.She makes him her guide.Meanwhile, Gandalf the Gray fights the Balrog, the Demon of Power.After the duel, the wizard is reborn as Gandalf the White.He joins Aragorn, Legolas the elf and Gimli the dwarf as they journey to Rohan.They must warn the local ruler Théoden about the war.It turns out that he can no longer rule.His faith and strength were robbed by a curse cast by Saruman.Merry and Pippin escape from orc captivity to Fangorn - an ancient forest.Treebeard, the shepherd of trees, takes care of them there.Middle-earth is threatened by great danger - Sauron, ruler of Mordor, and the wizard Saruman, lord of Isengard, unite their forces.Troops of wild Uruk-hai are growing in strength.The day of the Battle of Helm's Deep is approaching.

programs.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programs.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programs.title: Towards the sun
programs.desc: The year 2057. People are increasingly concerned about what is happening to the Sun.It seems to be losing power, and the Earth dependent on it is gradually becoming covered with ice.Scientists are sending an expedition towards the Sun whose task is to place a powerful nuclear charge on its surface.Experts predict that such an explosion will stimulate the star's activity and thus save the world from destruction.After some time, however, it turns out that a similar mission had already taken place seven years earlier, but then none of the crew managed to return to Earth.This time, eight people are sent into space, commanded by the experienced Captain Kaneda.The Icarus II board includes, among others:Cassie, Capa, Corazon and Mace.It quickly turns out that someone is making every effort to prevent the expedition members from reaching their goal.Soon, one of the pilots makes a fatal mistake and deprives the crew of oxygen supplies.In addition, unexpectedly, the ship begins to receive warning signals from its predecessor.The situation is becoming more and more dramatic.
